\"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Types to represent unstructured mesh elements\nusing idx_t = uint64_t;\nusing val_t = double;\n\n// Maximum number of connections per element (for a 2D grid: 4 neighbors)\nconstexpr int MAX_CONNECTIONS = 8;\n\n// Material properties for energy transfer\nstruct Material {\n    val_t transfer_coeff;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\n\n// World state\nstruct World {\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, const ElementDynamic& this_elem,\n                        val_t connection_flux, const ElementDynamic& other_elem) {\n    return (other_elem.current_energy - this_elem.current_energy) * \n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n            \n            // Start with external flow\n            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n            \n            // Add flux from all connected elements\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];\n                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n            }\n            \n            // Update element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n        }\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const World& world) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    \n    for (const auto& elem : world.elements_dynamic) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Validation results:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Energy sum: %.12f\\n\", energy_sum);\n    printf(\"  Flux sum: %.2f\\n\", flux_sum);\n    printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n    \n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\\n\");\n        // Don't fail validation as this can happen with external flows\n    }\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification\nuint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int n_elems_root = 512;\n    int n_iters = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(ElementDynamic) == 2 * sizeof(val_t), \"ElementDynamic must be two packed values\");\n\n// A contiguous block of values exchanged with one peer rank\nstruct Link {\n    int peer;\n    size_t offset;  // Offset into the halo buffer (recv) or the send index list (send)\n    size_t count;\n};\n\n// Distributed world: each rank owns a contiguous block of global element indices.\n// Energy buffers hold the owned elements followed by halo copies of remote neighbors.\nstruct World {\n    idx_t global_begin = 0;                      // First global element index owned by this rank\n    idx_t n_local = 0;                           // Number of owned elements\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;  // Owned elements; connected_idx indexes energy[]\n    std::vector<val_t> total_flux;               // Accumulated flux magnitude per owned element\n    std::vector<val_t> energy;                   // Current energy: owned, then halo\n    std::vector<val_t> energy_swap;              // Next energy (same layout as energy)\n    std::vector<idx_t> interior;                 // Owned elements with no halo neighbors\n    std::vector<idx_t> boundary;                 // Owned elements with at least one halo neighbor\n    std::vector<Link> recv_links;\n    std::vector<Link> send_links;\n    std::vector<idx_t> send_indices;             // Local indices of owned values sent to peers\n    std::vector<val_t> send_buf;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Owned range boundaries: rank r owns global indices [bounds[r], bounds[r+1])\nstd::vector<idx_t> makeBounds(idx_t n_elems, int nranks) {\n    std::vector<idx_t> bounds(nranks + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= nranks; ++r) {\n        bounds[r] = n_elems * static_cast<idx_t>(r) / static_cast<idx_t>(nranks);\n    }\n    return bounds;\n}\n\n// Rank that owns global element g\nint ownerOf(const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, idx_t g) {\n    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(bounds.begin(), bounds.end(), g) - bounds.begin()) - 1;\n}\n\n// Material of global element g. Corner assignments are applied in the same order as the serial builder.\nidx_t materialOf(idx_t g, idx_t n) {\n    const idx_t last = n - 1;\n    idx_t mat = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == 0) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n + last) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    return mat;\n}\n\n// Global neighbors of element g in a 2D square grid (up, down, left, right, in-bounds only)\nint neighborsOf(idx_t g, idx_t n, idx_t out[4]) {\n    const long long x = static_cast<long long>(g / n);\n    const long long y = static_cast<long long>(g % n);\n    const long long offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {\n        const long long nx = x + offsets[k][0];\n        const long long ny = y + offsets[k][1];\n        if (nx >= 0 && nx < static_cast<long long>(n) && ny >= 0 && ny < static_cast<long long>(n)) {\n            out[count++] = static_cast<idx_t>(nx) * n + static_cast<idx_t>(ny);\n        }\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\n// Build this rank's share of the 2D square grid unstructured mesh and its communication pattern\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root, const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, const int rank) {\n    const idx_t n = static_cast<idx_t>(n_elems_root);\n    const int nranks = static_cast<int>(bounds.size()) - 1;\n    const idx_t gbeg = bounds[rank];\n    const idx_t gend = bounds[rank + 1];\n    const idx_t n_local = gend - gbeg;\n\n    world.global_begin = gbeg;\n    world.n_local = n_local;\n\n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials = {Material{0.8, 0.0},    // Default material\n                       Material{0.8, 0.5},    // Inflow material\n                       Material{0.8, -0.5}};  // Outflow material\n\n    // Collect remote neighbors needed by owned elements, sorted and unique.\n    // Sorting groups them by owner, so each peer's values form one contiguous halo slice.\n    std::vector<idx_t> remote;\n    for (idx_t g = gbeg; g < gend; ++g) {\n        idx_t nb[4];\n        const int count = neighborsOf(g, n, nb);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            if (nb[k] < gbeg || nb[k] >= gend) remote.push_back(nb[k]);\n        }\n    }\n    std::sort(remote.begin(), remote.end());\n    remote.erase(std::unique(remote.begin(), remote.end()), remote.end());\n\n    // Receive side: how many values come from each peer\n    std::vector<int> recv_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    for (idx_t g : remote) recv_cnt[ownerOf(bounds, g)]++;\n\n    world.recv_links.clear();\n    size_t halo_off = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (recv_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.recv_links.push_back(Link{q, halo_off, static_cast<size_t>(recv_cnt[q])});\n        }\n        halo_off += static_cast<size_t>(recv_cnt[q]);\n    }\n\n    // Send side: each owner learns which of its elements the other ranks need\n    std::vector<int> send_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    MPI_Alltoall(recv_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, send_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    std::vector<int> recv_disp(nranks, 0), send_disp(nranks, 0);\n    int recv_total = 0, send_total = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        recv_disp[q] = recv_total;\n        send_disp[q] = send_total;\n        recv_total += recv_cnt[q];\n        send_total += send_cnt[q];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<idx_t> wanted(send_total);\n    MPI_Alltoallv(remote.data(), recv_cnt.data(), recv_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T,\n                  wanted.data(), send_cnt.data(), send_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    world.send_links.clear();\n    world.send_indices.resize(send_total);\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (send_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.send_links.push_back(Link{q, static_cast<size_t>(send_disp[q]), static_cast<size_t>(send_cnt[q])});\n        }\n    }\n    for (int k = 0; k < send_total; ++k) {\n        world.send_indices[k] = wanted[k] - gbeg;  // Owned by this rank by construction\n    }\n    world.send_buf.assign(send_total, 0.0);\n\n    // Local element state and connectivity\n    world.elements_static.assign(n_local, ElementStatic{});\n    world.interior.clear();\n    world.boundary.clear();\n    for (idx_t i = 0; i < n_local; ++i) {\n        const idx_t g = gbeg + i;\n        ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[i];\n        elem.material_idx = materialOf(g, n);\n        elem.num_connections = 0;\n\n        // Same neighbor order as the serial builder; remote neighbors map to halo slots\n        idx_t nb[4];\n        const int count = neighborsOf(g, n, nb);\n        bool has_halo = false;\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            idx_t local;\n            if (nb[k] >= gbeg && nb[k] < gend) {\n                local = nb[k] - gbeg;\n            } else {\n                local = n_local + static_cast<idx_t>(std::lower_bound(remote.begin(), remote.end(), nb[k]) - remote.begin());\n                has_halo = true;\n            }\n            elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = local;\n            elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n            elem.num_connections++;\n        }\n        (has_halo ? world.boundary : world.interior).push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    world.total_flux.assign(n_local, 0.0);\n    world.energy.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n    world.energy_swap.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, val_t this_energy,\n                         val_t connection_flux, val_t other_energy) {\n    return (other_energy - this_energy) *\n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Update one owned element from the current energies into the next buffer\ninline void updateElement(World& world, idx_t i, const val_t* cur, val_t* nxt) {\n    const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n    const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n    const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n    // Start with external flow\n    val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n    // Add flux from all connected elements\n    for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n        flux += computeFlux(mat, self, elem_static.connected_flux[j], cur[elem_static.connected_idx[j]]);\n    }\n\n    nxt[i] = self + flux;\n    world.total_flux[i] += std::abs(flux);\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const idx_t n_local = world.n_local;\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(world.recv_links.size() + world.send_links.size());\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        val_t* cur = world.energy.data();\n        val_t* nxt = world.energy_swap.data();\n\n        // Post halo receives and sends of the current energies\n        int nreq = 0;\n        for (const Link& link : world.recv_links) {\n            MPI_Irecv(cur + n_local + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < world.send_indices.size(); ++k) {\n            world.send_buf[k] = cur[world.send_indices[k]];\n        }\n        for (const Link& link : world.send_links) {\n            MPI_Isend(world.send_buf.data() + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n\n        // Interior elements need no remote data, so compute them while the halo is in flight\n        for (idx_t i : world.interior) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Waitall(nreq, reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n        for (idx_t i : world.boundary) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.energy, world.energy_swap);\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    for (const auto& elem : elements) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Validation results:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Energy sum: %.12f\\n\", energy_sum);\n    printf(\"  Flux sum: %.2f\\n\", flux_sum);\n    printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n\n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\\n\");\n        // Don't fail validation as this can happen with external flows\n    }\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification.\n// Each term depends only on its global index and XOR is order-independent, so\n// partial hashes of disjoint ranges combine exactly into the full hash.\nuint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements, idx_t global_offset) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < elements.size(); ++i) {\n        const idx_t gi = global_offset + i;\n        // Simple hash combining energy and flux values\n        const uint64_t* e_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].current_energy);\n        const uint64_t* f_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].total_flux);\n        hash ^= (*e_ptr + gi) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n        hash ^= (*f_ptr + gi) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN elements) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of simulation iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable rank = 0;\n    int nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    int n_elems_root = 512;\n    int n_iters = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_elems_root = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_iters = if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (n_elems_root <= 0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Grid size must be printf(\"Grid size: %d x %d = %d elements\\n\", n_elems_root, n_elems_root, n_elems);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", n_iters);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", nranks);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Build the unstructured mesh\n        printf(\"Building unstructured mesh...\\n\");\n    }\n    const std::vector<idx_t> bounds = makeBounds(n_total, nranks);\n    World world;\n    buildSquare2D(world, n_elems_root, bounds, rank);\n\n    // Calculate memory usage (global, as in the serial version)\n    if (root) {\n        const size_t static_mem = n_total * sizeof(ElementStatic);\n        const size_t dynamic_mem = n_total * sizeof(ElementDynamic) * 2;\n        const size_t total_mem = static_mem MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    runSimulation(world, n_iters, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double max_elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &max_elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Final owned state\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> local_state(world.n_local);\n    for (idx_t i = 0;             // Local indices of owned values sent to peers\n    std::vector<val_t> send_buf;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Owned range boundaries: rank r owns global indices [bounds[r], bounds[r+1])\nstd::vector<idx_t> makeBounds(idx_t n_elems, int nranks) {\n    std::vector<idx_t> bounds(nranks + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= nranks; ++r) {\n        bounds[r] = n_elems * static_cast<idx_t>(r) / static_cast<idx_t>(nranks);\n    }\n    return bounds;\n}\n\n// Rank that owns global element g\nint ownerOf(const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, idx_t g) {\n    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(bounds.begin(), bounds.end(), g) - bounds.begin()) - 1;\n}\n\n// Material of global element g. Corner assignments are applied in the same order as the serial builder.\nidx_t materialOf(idx_t g, idx_t n) {\n    const idx_t last = n - 1;\n    idx_t mat = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == 0) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n + last) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    return mat;\n}\n\n// Global neighbors of element g in a 2D square grid (up, down, left, right, in-bounds only)\nint neighborsOf(idx_t g, idx_t n, idx_t out[4]) {\n    const long long x = static_cast<long long>(g / n);\n    const long long y = static_cast<long long>(g % n);\n    const long long offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {\n        const long long nx = x + offsets[k][0];\n        const long long ny = y + offsets[k][1];\n        if (nx >= 0 && nx < static_cast<long long>(n) && ny >= 0 && ny < static_cast<long long>(n)) {\n            out[count++] = buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root, const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, const int rank) {\n    const idx_t n = static_cast<idx_t>(n_elems_root);\n    const int nranks = world.n_local = n_local;\n\n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials = {Material{0.8, 0.0},    // Default material\n                       Material{0.8, 0.5},    // Inflow material\n < count; ++k) {\n            if (nb[k] < gbeg || nb[k] >= gend) remote.push_back(nb[k]);\n        }\n    }\n    std::sort(remote.begin(), remote.end());\n    remote.erase(std::unique(remote.begin(), remote.end()), remote.end());\n\n    // Receive side: how many values come from each peer\n    std::vector<int> recv_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    for (idx_t g : remote) recv_cnt[ownerOf(bounds, g)]++;\n\n    world.recv_links.clear();\n    size_t halo_off = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (recv_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.recv_links.push_back(Link{q, halo_off, static_cast<size_t>(recv_cnt[q])});\n        }\n        halo_off += static_cast<size_t>(recv_cnt[q]);\n    }\n\n    // Send side: each owner learns which of its elements the other ranks need\n    std::vector<int> send_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    MPI_Alltoall(recv_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, send_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    std::vector<int> recv_disp(nranks, 0), send_disp(nranks, 0);\n    int recv_total = 0, send_total = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        recv_disp[q] = recv_total;\n        send_disp[q] = send_total;\n        recv_total += recv_cnt[q];\n        send_total += send_cnt[q];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<idx_t> wanted(send_total);\n    MPI_Alltoallv(remote.data(), recv_cnt.data(), recv_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T,\n                  wanted.data(), send_cnt.data(), send_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    world.send_links.clear();\n    world.send_indices.resize(send_total);\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (send_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.send_links.push_back(Link{q, static_cast<size_t>(send_disp[q]), static_cast<size_t>(send_cnt[q])});\n        }\n    }\n    for (int k = 0; k < send_total; ++k) {\n        world.send_indices[k] = wanted[k] - gbeg;  // Owned by this rank by construction\n    }\n    world.send_buf.assign(send_total, 0.0);\n\n    // Local element state and connectivity\n    world.elements_static.assign(n_local, ElementStatic{});\n    world.interior.clear();\n    world.boundary.clear();\n    for (idx_t i = 0; i < n_local; ++i) {\n        const idx_t g = gbeg + i;\n        ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[i];\n        elem.material_idx = materialOf(g, n);\n        elem.num_connections = 0;\n\n        // Same neighbor order as the serial builder; remote local;\n            if (nb[k] >= gbeg && nb[k] < gend) {\n                local = nb[k] - gbeg;\n            } else {\n                local = n_local + static_cast<idx_t>(std::lower_bound(remote.begin(), remote.end(), nb[k]) - remote.begin());\n                has_halo = true;\n            }\n            elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = local;\n            elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n            elem.num_connections++;\n        }\n        (has_halo ? world.boundary : world.interior).push_back(i);\n    }\n\n elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, val_t this_energy,\n                         val_t connection_flux, val_t other_energy) {\n    return (other_energy - this_energy) *\n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Update one owned element from the current energies into the next buffer\ninline void updateElement(World& world, idx_t i, const val_t* cur, val_t* nxt) {\n    const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n    const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n    const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n    // Start with external flow\n    val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n    // Add flux from all connected elements\n    for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n        flux += computeFlux(mat, self, elem_static.connected_flux[j], cur[elem_static.connected_idx[j]]);\n    }\n\n    nxt[i] = self + flux;\n    world.total_flux[i] += std::abs(flux);\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const idx_t n_local = world.n_local;\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(world.recv_links.size() + world.send_links.size());\n\n elements) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n\n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n send_total += send_cnt[q];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<idx_t> wanted(send_total);\n    MPI_Alltoallv(remote.data(), recv_cnt.data(), recv_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T,\n                  wanted.data(), skip the deprecated C++ bindings\n#define MPI_NO_CPPBIND 1\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Types to represent unstructured mesh elements\nusing idx_t = uint64_t;\nusing val_t = double;\n\n// Maximum number of connections per element (for a 2D grid: 4 neighbors)\nconstexpr int MAX_CONNECTIONS = 8;\n\n// Material properties for energy transfer\nstruct Material {\n    val_t transfer_coeff;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(ElementDynamic) == 2 * sizeof(val_t), \"ElementDynamic must be two packed values\");\n\n// A contiguous block of values exchanged with one peer rank\nstruct Link {\n    int peer;\n    size_t offset;  // Offset into the halo buffer (recv) or the send index list (send)\n    size_t count;\n};\n\n// Distributed world: each rank owns a contiguous block of global element indices.\n// Energy buffers hold the owned elements followed by halo copies of remote neighbors.\nstruct World {\n    idx_t global_begin = 0;                      // First global element index owned by this rank\n    idx_t n_local = 0;                           // Number of owned elements\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;  // Owned elements; connected_idx indexes energy[]\n    std::vector<val_t> total_flux;               // Accumulated flux magnitude per owned element\n    std::vector<val_t> energy;                   // Current energy: owned, then halo\n    std::vector<val_t> energy_swap;              // Next energy (same layout as energy)\n    std::vector<idx_t> interior;                 // Owned elements with no halo neighbors\n    std::vector<idx_t> boundary;                 // Owned elements with at least one halo neighbor\n    std::vector<Link> recv_links;\n    std::vector<Link> send_links;\n    std::vector<idx_t> send_indices;             // Local indices of owned values sent to peers\n    std::vector<val_t> send_buf;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Owned range boundaries: rank r owns global indices [bounds[r], bounds[r+1])\nstd::vector<idx_t> makeBounds(idx_t n_elems, int nranks) {\n    std::vector<idx_t> bounds(nranks + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= nranks; ++r) {\n        bounds[r] = n_elems * static_cast<idx_t>(r) / static_cast<idx_t>(nranks);\n    }\n    return bounds;\n}\n\n// Rank that owns global element g\nint ownerOf(const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, idx_t g) {\n    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(bounds.begin(), bounds.end(), g) - bounds.begin()) - 1;\n}\n\n// Material of global element g. Corner assignments are applied in the same order as the serial builder.\nidx_t materialOf(idx_t g, idx_t n) {\n    const idx_t last = n - 1;\n    idx_t mat = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == 0) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n + last) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    return mat;\n}\n\n// Global neighbors of element g in a 2D square grid (up, down, left, right, in-bounds only)\nint neighborsOf(idx_t g, idx_t n, idx_t out[4]) {\n    const long long x = static_cast<long long>(g / n);\n    const long long y = static_cast<long long>(g % n);\n    const long long offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {\n        const long long nx = x + offsets[k][0];\n        const long long ny = y + offsets[k][1];\n        if (nx >= 0 && nx < static_cast<long long>(n) && ny >= 0 && ny < static_cast<long long>(n)) {\n            out[count++] = static_cast<idx_t>(nx) * n + static_cast<idx_t>(ny);\n        }\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\n// Build this rank's share of the 2D square grid unstructured mesh and its communication pattern\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root, const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, const int rank) {\n    const idx_t n = static_cast<idx_t>(n_elems_root);\n    const int nranks = static_cast<int>(bounds.size()) - 1;\n    const idx_t gbeg = bounds[rank];\n    const idx_t gend = bounds[rank + 1];\n    const idx_t n_local = gend - gbeg;\n\n    world.global_begin = gbeg;\n skip the deprecated C++ bindings\n#define MPI_NO_CPPBIND 1\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Types to represent unstructured mesh elements\nusing idx_t = uint64_t;\nusing val_t = double;\n\n// Maximum number of connections per element (for a 2D grid: 4 neighbors)\nconstexpr int MAX_CONNECTIONS = 8;\n\n// Material properties for energy transfer\nstruct Material {\n    val_t transfer_coeff;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(ElementDynamic) == 2 * sizeof(val_t), \"ElementDynamic must be two packed values\");\n\n// A contiguous block of values exchanged with one peer rank\nstruct Link {\n    int peer;\n    size_t offset;  // Offset into the halo buffer (recv) or the send index list (send)\n    size_t count;\n};\n\n// Distributed world: each rank owns a contiguous block of global element indices.\n// Energy buffers hold the owned elements followed by halo copies of remote neighbors.\nstruct World {\n    idx_t global_begin = 0;                      // First global element index owned by this rank\n    idx_t n_local = 0;                           // Number of owned elements\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;  // Owned elements; connected_idx indexes energy[]\n    std::vector<val_t> total_flux;               // Accumulated flux magnitude per owned element\n    std::vector<val_t> energy;                   // Current energy: owned, then halo\n    std::vector<val_t> energy_swap;              // Next energy (same layout as energy)\n    std::vector<idx_t> interior;                 // Owned elements with no halo neighbors\n    std::vector<idx_t> boundary;                 // Owned elements with at least one halo neighbor\n    std::vector<Link> recv_links;\n    std::vector<Link> send_links;\n    std::vector<idx_t> send_indices;             // Local indices of owned values sent to peers\n    std::vector<val_t> send_buf;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Owned range boundaries: rank r owns global indices [bounds[r], bounds[r+1])\nstd::vector<idx_t> makeBounds(idx_t n_elems, int nranks) {\n    std::vector<idx_t> bounds(nranks + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= nranks; ++r) {\n        bounds[r] = n_elems * static_cast<idx_t>(r) / static_cast<idx_t>(nranks);\n    }\n    return bounds;\n}\n\n// Rank that owns global element g\nint ownerOf(const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, idx_t g) {\n    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(bounds.begin(), bounds.end(), g) - bounds.begin()) - 1;\n}\n\n// Material of global element g. Corner assignments are applied in the same order as the serial builder.\nidx_t materialOf(idx_t g, idx_t n) {\n    const idx_t last = n - 1;\n    idx_t mat = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == 0) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n + last) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    return mat;\n}\n\n// Global neighbors of element g in a 2D square grid (up, down, left, right, in-bounds only)\nint neighborsOf(idx_t g, idx_t n, idx_t out[4]) {\n    const long long x = static_cast<long long>(g / n);\n    const long long y = static_cast<long long>(g % n);\n    const long long offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {\n        const long long nx = x + offsets[k][0];\n        const long long ny = y + offsets[k][1];\n        if (nx >= 0 && nx < static_cast<long long>(n) && ny >= 0 && ny < static_cast<long long>(n)) {\n            out[count++] = static_cast<idx_t>(nx) * n + static_cast<idx_t>(ny);\n        }\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\n// Build this rank's share of the 2D square grid unstructured mesh and its communication pattern\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root, const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, const int rank) {\n    const idx_t n = static_cast<idx_t>(n_elems_root);\n    const int nranks = static_cast<int>(bounds.size()) - 1;\n    const idx_t gbeg = bounds[rank];\n    const idx_t gend = bounds[rank + 1];\n    const idx_t n_local = gend - gbeg;\n\n    world.global_begin = gbeg;\n    world.n_local = n_local;\n\n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials = {Material{0.8, 0.0},    // Default material\n                       Material{0.8, 0.5},    // Inflow material\n                       Material{0.8, -0.5}};  // Outflow material\n\n    // Collect remote neighbors needed by owned elements, sorted and unique.\n    // Sorting groups them by owner, so each peer's values form one contiguous halo slice.\n    std::vector<idx_t> remote;\n    for (idx_t g = gbeg; g < gend; ++g) {\n        idx_t nb[4];\n        const int count = neighborsOf(g, n, nb);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            if (nb[k] < gbeg || nb[k] >= gend) remote.push_back(nb[k]);\n        }\n    }\n    std::sort(remote.begin(), remote.end());\n    remote.erase(std::unique(remote.begin(), remote.end()), remote.end());\n\n    // Receive side: how many values come from each peer\n    std::vector<int> recv_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    for (idx_t g : remote) recv_cnt[ownerOf(bounds, g)]++;\n\n    world.recv_links.clear();\n    size_t halo_off = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (recv_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.recv_links.push_back(Link{q, halo_off, static_cast<size_t>(recv_cnt[q])});\n        }\n        halo_off += static_cast<size_t>(recv_cnt[q]);\n    }\n\n    // Send side: each owner learns which of its elements the other ranks need\n    std::vector<int> send_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    MPI_Alltoall(recv_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, send_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    std::vector<int> recv_disp(nranks, 0), send_disp(nranks, 0);\n    int recv_total = 0, send_total = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        recv_disp[q] = recv_total;\n        send_disp[q] = send_total;\n        recv_total += recv_cnt[q];\n        send_total += send_cnt[q];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<idx_t> wanted(send_total);\n    MPI_Alltoallv(remote.data(), recv_cnt.data(), recv_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T,\n                  wanted.data(), send_cnt.data(), send_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    world.send_links.clear();\n    world.send_indices.resize(send_total);\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (send_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.send_links.push_back(Link{q, static_cast<size_t>(send_disp[q]), static_cast<size_t>(send_cnt[q])});\n        }\n    }\n    for (int k = 0; k < send_total; ++k) {\n        world.send_indices[k] = wanted[k] - gbeg;  // Owned by this rank by construction\n    }\n    world.send_buf.assign(send_total, 0.0);\n\n    // Local element state and connectivity\n    world.elements_static.assign(n_local, ElementStatic{});\n    world.interior.clear();\n    world.boundary.clear();\n    for (idx_t i = 0; i < n_local; ++i) {\n        const idx_t g = gbeg + i;\n        ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[i];\n        elem.material_idx = materialOf(g, n);\n        elem.num_connections = 0;\n\n        // Same neighbor order as the serial builder; remote neighbors map to halo slots\n        idx_t nb[4];\n        const int count = neighborsOf(g, n, nb);\n        bool has_halo = false;\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            idx_t local;\n            if (nb[k] >= gbeg && nb[k] < gend) {\n                local = nb[k] - gbeg;\n            } else {\n                local = n_local + static_cast<idx_t>(std::lower_bound(remote.begin(), remote.end(), nb[k]) - remote.begin());\n                has_halo = true;\n            }\n            elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = local;\n            elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n            elem.num_connections++;\n        }\n        (has_halo ? world.boundary : world.interior).push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    world.total_flux.assign(n_local, 0.0);\n    world.energy.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n    world.energy_swap.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, val_t this_energy,\n                         val_t connection_flux, val_t other_energy) {\n    return (other_energy - this_energy) *\n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Update one owned element from the current energies into the next buffer\ninline void updateElement(World& world, idx_t i, const val_t* cur, val_t* nxt) {\n    const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n    const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n    const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n    // Start with external flow\n    val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n    // Add flux from all connected elements\n    for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n        flux += computeFlux(mat, self, elem_static.connected_flux[j], cur[elem_static.connected_idx[j]]);\n    }\n\n    nxt[i] = self + flux;\n    world.total_flux[i] += std::abs(flux);\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const idx_t n_local = world.n_local;\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(world.recv_links.size() + world.send_links.size());\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        val_t* cur = world.energy.data();\n        val_t* nxt = world.energy_swap.data();\n\n        // Post halo receives and sends of the current energies\n        int nreq = 0;\n        for (const Link& link : world.recv_links) {\n            MPI_Irecv(cur + n_local + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < world.send_indices.size(); ++k) {\n            world.send_buf[k] = cur[world.send_indices[k]];\n        }\n        for (const Link& link : world.send_links) {\n            MPI_Isend(world.send_buf.data() + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n\n        // Interior elements need no remote data, so compute them while the halo is in flight\n        for (idx_t i : world.interior) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Waitall(nreq, reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n        for (idx_t i : world.boundary) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.energy, world.energy_swap);\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    for (const auto& elem : elements) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Validation results:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Energy sum: %.12f\\n\", energy_sum);\n    printf(\"  Flux sum: %.2f\\n\", flux_sum);\n    printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n\n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\\n\");\n        // Don't fail validation as this can happen with external flows\n    }\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification.\n// Each term depends only on its global index and XOR is order-independent, so\n// partial hashes of disjoint ranges combine exactly into the full hash.\nuint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements, idx_t global_offset) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < elements.size(); ++i) {\n        const idx_t gi = global_offset + i;\n        // Simple hash combining energy and flux values\n        const uint64_t* e_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].current_energy);\n        const uint64_t* f_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].total_flux);\n        hash ^= (*e_ptr + gi) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n        hash ^= (*f_ptr + gi) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN elements) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of simulation iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    int n_elems_root = 512;\n    int n_iters = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_elems_root = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_iters = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (n_elems_root <= 0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Grid size must be positive\\n\");\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    const idx_t n_total = static_cast<idx_t>(n_elems);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Unstructured Mesh Energy Transfer Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"============================================\\n\");\n        printf(\"Grid size: %d x %d = %d elements\\n\", n_elems_root, n_elems_root, n_elems);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", n_iters);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Build the unstructured mesh\n        printf(\"Building unstructured mesh...\\n\");\n    }\n    const std::vector<idx_t> bounds = makeBounds(n_total, nranks);\n    World world;\n    buildSquare2D(world, n_elems_root, bounds, rank);\n\n    // Calculate memory usage (global, as in the serial version)\n    if (root) {\n        const size_t static_mem = n_total * sizeof(ElementStatic);\n        const size_t dynamic_mem = n_total * sizeof(ElementDynamic) * 2;\n        const size_t total_mem = static_mem + dynamic_mem;\n        printf(\"Memory usage: %.2f MB (static: %.2f MB, dynamic: %.2f MB)\\n\",\n               total_mem / (1024.0 * 1024.0),\n               static_mem / (1024.0 * 1024.0),\n               dynamic_mem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n        printf(\"Running simulation...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Run simulation; the reported time is the slowest rank\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    runSimulation(world, n_iters, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double max_elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &max_elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Final owned state\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> local_state(world.n_local);\n    for (idx_t i = 0; i < world.n_local; ++i) {\n        local_state[i].current_energy = world.energy[i];\n        local_state[i].total_flux = world.total_flux[i];\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        const long duration_ms = static_cast<long>(max_elapsed * 1000.0);\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration_ms);\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const int n_measured_iters = std::max(n_iters - 1, 1);\n        const double time_per_iter = static_cast<double>(duration_ms) / n_measured_iters;\n        const double giga_elems_per_sec = (n_measured_iters * n_elems) / printf(\"Performance:\\n\");\n        printf(\"  Time per iteration: %.4f ms\\n\", time_per_iter);\n        printf(\"  Elements/sec: %.4f GigaElements/s\\n\", giga_elems_per_sec);\n        printf(\" {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzBEihrhTy5zVNXytcgD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016xnA9gD1P5wZLT9TbXswQX","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r3/unstructured/unstructured.cpp","old_string":"// Update one owned element from the current energies into the next buffer\ninline void updateElement(World& world, idx_t i, const val_t* cur, val_t* nxt) {\n    const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n    const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n    const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n    // Start with external flow\n    val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n    // Add flux from all connected elements\n    for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n        flux += computeFlux(mat, self, elem_static.connected_flux[j], cur[elem_static.connected_idx[j]]);\n    }\n\n    nxt[i] = self + flux;\n    world.total_flux[i] += std::abs(flux);\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const idx_t n_local = world.n_local;\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(world.recv_links.size() + world.send_links.size());\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        val_t* cur = world.energy.data();\n        val_t* nxt = world.energy_swap.data();\n\n        // Post halo receives and sends of the current energies\n        int nreq = 0;\n        for (const Link& link : world.recv_links) {\n            MPI_Irecv(cur + n_local + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < world.send_indices.size(); ++k) {\n            world.send_buf[k] = cur[world.send_indices[k]];\n        }\n        for (const Link& link : world.send_links) {\n            MPI_Isend(world.send_buf.data() + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n\n        // Interior elements need no remote data, so compute them while the halo is in flight\n        for (idx_t i : world.interior) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Waitall(nreq, reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n        for (idx_t i : world.boundary) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }","new_string":"// Update the listed owned elements from the current energies into the next buffer.\n// Works on raw pointers so the hot loop keeps its base addresses in registers.\nvoid updateElements(const idx_t* ids, size_t count, const ElementStatic* elems, const Material* mats,\n                    val_t* total_flux, const val_t* cur, val_t* nxt) {\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n        const idx_t i = ids[k];\n        const ElementStatic& elem_static = elems[i];\n        const Material& mat = mats[elem_static.material_idx];\n        const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n        // Start with external flow\n        val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n        // Add flux from all connected elements\n        for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n            flux += computeFlux(mat, self, elem_static.connected_flux[j], cur[elem_static.connected_idx[j]]);\n        }\n\n        nxt[i] = self + flux;\n        total_flux[i] += std::abs(flux);\n    }\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const idx_t n_local = world.n_local;\n    const ElementStatic* elems = world.elements_static.data();\n    const Material* mats = world.materials.data();\n    val_t* total_flux = world.total_flux.data();\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(world.recv_links.size() + world.send_links.size());\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        val_t* cur = world.energy.data();\n        val_t* nxt = world.energy_swap.data();\n\n        // Post halo receives and sends of the current energies\n        int nreq = 0;\n        for (const Link& link : world.recv_links) {\n            MPI_Irecv(cur + n_local + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < world.send_indices.size(); ++k) {\n            world.send_buf[k] = cur[world.send_indices[k]];\n        }\n        for (const Link& link : world.send_links) {\n            MPI_Isend(world.send_buf.data() + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                      link.peer, 0, comm, &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n\n        // Interior elements need no remote data, so compute them while the halo is in flight\n        updateElements(world.interior.data(), world.interior.size(), elems, mats, total_flux, cur, nxt);\n\n        MPI_Waitall(nreq, reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n        updateElements(world.boundary.data(), world.boundary.size(), elems, mats, total_flux, cur, nxt);"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":744,"cache_read_input_tokens":66547,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":744},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7c815389-f1fb-43f0-b9e9-5fa66e3b87f1","uuid":"0c43369b-8aea-4d3f-8e5f-6db69c7748f5","timestamp":"2026-10-13T11:43:44.669Z","request_id":"req_011CfzBEiPGW7WMFfhciQTJ4"}

k < count; ++k) {\n        const idx_t i = ids[k];\n        const ElementStatic& elem_static = elems[i];\n        const Material& mat = mats[elem_static.material_idx];\n        const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n        // Start with external flow\n        val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n        // Add flux from all connected elements\n        for (idx_t j = 0;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];  // Offset into the halo buffer (recv) or the send index list (send)\n    size_t count;\n};\n\n// Distributed world: each rank owns a contiguous block of global element indices.\n// Energy buffers hold the owned elements followed by halo copies of remote neighbors.\nstruct World {\n    idx_t global_begin = 0; r <= nranks; ++r) {\n        bounds[r] = n_elems * static_cast<idx_t>(r) / static_cast<idx_t>(nranks);\n    }\n    return bounds;\n}\n\n// Rank that owns global element g\nint ownerOf(const std::vector<idx_t>& bounds, idx_t g) {\n    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(bounds.begin(), bounds.end(), g) - bounds.begin()) - 1;\n}\n\n// Material of global element g. Corner assignments are applied in the same order as the serial builder.\nidx_t materialOf(idx_t g, idx_t n) {\n    const idx_t last = n - 1;\n    idx_t mat = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == 0) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n) mat = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    if (g == last * n + last) mat = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    return mat;\n}\n\n// Global neighbors of element g in a 2D square grid (up, down, left, right, in-bounds only)\nint neighborsOf(idx_t g, idx_t n, idx_t out[4]) {\n    const long long x = static_cast<long long>(g / n);\n    const long long y = static_cast<long long>(g % n);\n    const long long offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {\n        const long long nx = x + offsets[k][0];\n        const long long ny = y + offsets[k][1];\n        if (nx >= 0 && nx < static_cast<long long>(n) && ny >= 0 && ny < static_cast<long long>(n)) {\n            out[count++] = world.n_local = n_local;\n\n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials = {Material{0.8, 0.0},    // Default material\n                       Material{0.8, 0.5},    // Inflow material\n world.recv_links.clear();\n    size_t halo_off = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < nranks; ++q) {\n        if (recv_cnt[q] > 0) {\n            world.recv_links.push_back(Link{q, halo_off, std::vector<int> send_cnt(nranks, 0);\n    MPI_Alltoall(recv_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, send_cnt.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    std::vector<int> recv_disp(nranks, 0), send_disp(nranks, 0);\n send_total += send_cnt[q];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<idx_t> wanted(send_total);\n    MPI_Alltoallv(remote.data(), recv_cnt.data(), recv_disp.data(), MPI_UINT64_T,\n                  wanted.data(), {\n        world.send_indices[k] = wanted[k] - gbeg;  // Owned by this rank by construction\n    }\n    world.send_buf.assign(send_total, 0.0);\n\n    // Local element state and connectivity\n    world.elements_static.assign(n_local, ElementStatic{});\n    world.interior.clear();\n    world.boundary.clear();\n    for (idx_t i = 0; i < n_local; ++i) {\n        const idx_t g = gbeg + i;\n local;\n            if (nb[k] >= gbeg && nb[k] < gend) {\n                local = nb[k] - gbeg;\n            } else {\n                local = n_local + world.total_flux.assign(n_local, 0.0);\n    world.energy.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n    world.energy_swap.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two nxt) {\n    const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n    const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n    const val_t self = cur[i];\n\n    // Start with external flow\n    val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n    // Add flux from all connected elements\n    for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n        flux += computeFlux(mat, self, elem_static.connected_flux[j], cur[elem_static.connected_idx[j]]);\n    }\n\n    nxt[i] = self + flux;\n    world.total_flux[i] += std::abs(flux);\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const idx_t n_local = world.n_local;\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(world.recv_links.size() + world.send_links.size());\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        val_t* cur = world.energy.data();\n        val_t* nxt = world.energy_swap.data();\n\n        // Post halo receives and sends of the current energies\n        int nreq = 0;\n        for (const Link& link : world.recv_links) {\n            MPI_Irecv(cur + n_local + link.offset, static_cast<int>(link.count), MPI_DOUBLE,\n &reqs[nreq++]);\n        }\n\n        // Interior elements need no remote data, so compute them while the halo is in flight\n        for (idx_t i : world.interior) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Waitall(nreq, reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n        for (idx_t i : world.boundary) {\n            updateElement(world, i, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    for (const auto& elem : elements) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Validation results:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Energy sum: %.12f\\n\", energy_sum);\n    printf(\"  Flux sum: %.2f\\n\", flux_sum);\n    printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n\n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n\n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification.\n// Each term depends only on its global index and XOR is order-independent, so\n// partial hashes of disjoint ranges combine exactly into the full hash.\nuint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements, idx_t global_offset) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < elements.size(); ++i) {\n        const idx_t gi = global_offset + i;\n        // Simple hash combining energy and flux values\n        const uint64_t* e_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].current_energy);\n        const uint64_t* f_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].total_flux);\n        hash ^= (*e_ptr + gi) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n        hash ^= (*f_ptr + gi) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n rank = 0;\n    int nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    int n_elems_root = 512;\n    int printf(\"Grid size: %d x %d = %d elements\\n\", n_elems_root, n_elems_root, n_elems);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", n_iters);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : const size_t static_mem = n_total * sizeof(ElementStatic);\n        const size_t dynamic_mem = n_total * sizeof(ElementDynamic) * 2;\n        const size_t total_mem = static_mem + dynamic_mem;\n (1024.0 * 1024.0));\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n        printf(\"Running simulation...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Run simulation; the reported time is the slowest rank\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    runSimulation(world, n_iters, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double max_elapsed = printf(\"Performance:\\n\");\n        printf(\"  Time per iteration: %.4f ms\\n\", time_per_iter);\n        printf(\"  Elements/sec: %.4f GigaElements/s\\n\", giga_elems_per_sec);\n        printf(\"  Performance: %.4f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Compute hash for verification\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    const uint64_t local_hash = computeHash(local_state, world.global_begin);\n all_state.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (root) {\n            // Print results for external validation\n            if (printResults) {\n local;\n            if (nb[k] >= gbeg && nb[k] < gend) {\n                local = nb[k] - gbeg;\n            } else {\n                local = n_local + world.boundary.push_back(i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    world.total_flux.assign(n_local, 0.0);\n    world.energy.assign(n_local + remote.size(), 0.0);\n    world.energy_swap.assign(n_local + buffer.\n// Works on raw pointers so the hot loop keeps its base addresses in registers.\ninline void updateElement(idx_t i, const ElementStatic* __restrict elems, const Material* __restrict mats,\n const ElementStatic* elems = world.elements_static.data();\n    const Material* mats = world.materials.data();\n    val_t* total_flux = world.total_flux.data();\n    const uint8_t* is_boundary = }\n\n        MPI_Waitall(nreq, reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n        for (idx_t i : world.boundary) {\n            updateElement(i, elems, mats, total_flux, cur, nxt);\n        }\n\n        // PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification.\n// Each term depends only on its global index and XOR is order-independent, so\n// partial hashes of hash ^= (*f_ptr + gi) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzCHXtS5dvqKgCa6pQsr","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs distributed with MPI, and its output matches the original serial program. Across 72 configurations (9 grid/iteration/flag combinations, each at 1–16 ranks), every non-timing line is identical, including the result hash, energy and flux sums, sampled values, and validation status. One caveat: a single rank runs about 20–35% slower than the original, which I didn't fully explain.\n\n**Changes (only `unstructured/unstructured.cpp` and `unstructured/CMakeLists.txt`)**\n\n- **Build:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable name is unchanged, and MPI is always used with no `#ifdef`.\n- **Decomposition:** each rank owns a contiguous block of global element indices. It builds only its own elements and keeps a halo of the remote neighbour energies it reads.\n- **Communication:** each step does a non-blocking halo exchange, and interior elements are computed while it is in flight. Only the energies that are actually read are sent.\n- **Exact results:**\n  - Each element's arithmetic and neighbour order are unchanged.\n  - The hash is XOR-reduced across ranks, which is exact in any order.\n  - With `-v` or `-r`, the full state is gathered to rank 0 and the original serial functions run there, so the printed sums keep their serial summation order.\n- **Exit status:** rank 0 decides it and broadcasts it, so all ranks return the same code.\n\n**Choices you may want to review**\n\n- `-n` must now be positive. The original hit undefined behaviour for `-n 0`, so it now prints an error and exits with 1.\n- Open MPI's C++ bindings produced warnings under `-Wall -Wextra`, so the code defines `OMPI_SKIP_MPICXX`. That macro is Open MPI-specific and harmless under MPICH.\n- The `Memory usage` line still reports global totals, as before.\n\n**Performance (2048×2048, 20 iterations, minimum of 3–5 runs, shared 256-core node)**\n\n| Ranks | Time |\n|---|---|\n| Original serial | 768 ms |\n| 1 | ~1050 ms |\n| 2 | 573 ms |\n| 4 | 214 ms |\n| 8 | 163 ms |\n| 16 | 143 ms |\n| 32 | 125 ms |\n| 64 | 73 ms |\n\nThe single-rank gap is still open. I tried removing an index list and adding `__restrict`, and neither closed it. The likely cause is the data layout, since energy and flux are now separate arrays rather than the original interleaved struct, but I did not confirm that.\n\n**Not tested:** a real multi-node cluster. All runs were on one machine, with up to 64 ranks.\n\nI did not commit anything, since you didn't ask for a commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1300,"cache_read_input_tokens":95186,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1300},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7c815389-f1fb-43f0-b9e9-5fa66e3b87f1","uuid":"95c85013-d826-4acf-a22e-de48b57f6afe","timestamp":"2026-10-13T11:57:23.411Z","request_id":"req_011CfzCHXW8EmRTKo691PZmq"}
